name: SS La Bretagne
builder: Ateliers et Chantiers de Saint-Nazaire Penhoët, Saint-Nazaire
summary: A French Line ocean liner built at Saint-Nazaire for Compagnie Générale Transatlantique’s Le Havre–New York service. Entering service in 1886, she belonged to the important late nineteenth-century group of CGT liners that helped modernize the company’s North Atlantic presence.
